evidence.title: AfD threatens to cut funding for 'modern-thinking' culture

occurrences.checkable_against: Sabine Schramm's professional biography and theater production records
occurrences.quote_span: She notes that throughout her 30-year career in theater, she has dealt with Germany's culture of remembrance, grappling with the horrors of Nazism on stage.
occurrences.speaker: Sabine Schramm
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Adolf Hitler's 1938 Reichenberger Rede and the AfD Saxony-Anhalt proposed slogan
occurrences.quote_span: The proposed "deutschdenken" slogan is one example of this: "'Deutsch denken' refers to a speech Adolf Hitler made in 1938" — the "Reichenberger Rede," noted Steiner.
occurrences.speaker: Barbara Steiner
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: AfD cultural policy program
occurrences.quote_span: Along with threats to funding, the AfD's program also describes Germany's existing culture of Holocaust remembrance as the "perpetuation of a guilt complex" that has "blocked the possibilities for forming a stable national identity."
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: AfD cultural policy program
occurrences.quote_span: It sees this as an "identity disorder" that needs to be "healed," by focusing on the "positive aspects of German history."
occurrences.speaker: AfD
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Kultur ist Vielfalt und Heimat joint statement
occurrences.quote_span: The initiative brings together a wide range of cultural institutions and artists from the region; they are warning in a joint statement that the AfD's plans could have far-reaching consequences for artistic freedom, historical memory, and public cultural life.
occurrences.speaker: Kultur ist Vielfalt und Heimat
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: AfD cultural policy program and Adolf Hitler-era propaganda texts
occurrences.quote_span: Yet in its cultural policy program, the far-right party regularly adopts the language used in Hitler's propaganda, downplays Nazi-era atrocities, challenges Germany's culture of remembrance and uses historically loaded language.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: AfD public statements and official party communications about comparisons with Nazism
occurrences.quote_span: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) strongly rejects comparisons to the Nazi party and Adolf Hitler, often dismissing them as trivializations of Nazi crimes.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: AfD Saxony-Anhalt cultural policy program and campaign materials
occurrences.quote_span: The AfD aims to adopt instead a campaign called "deutschdenken" (thinking German), which would downplay the role of Bauhaus and instead "highlight the state's significant contributions to the development of the German nation — from Henry I and Otto I to Luther, Bismarck and Nietzsche."
occurrences.speaker: AfD
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of Hans-Thomas Tillschneider's speech in Saxony-Anhalt's parliament
occurrences.quote_span: Tillschneider said, "Anti-German art is German art that doesn't want to be German."
occurrences.speaker: Hans-Thomas Tillschneider
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: AfD Saxony-Anhalt program and Saxony-Anhalt government image campaign materials
occurrences.quote_span: The AfD Saxony-Anhalt's program describes Bauhaus as "a controversial school of architecture" and criticizes the current state government for putting too much emphasis on this landmark attraction in their current image campaign, titled "moderndenken" (thinking modern).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: AfD Saxony-Anhalt cultural policy program
occurrences.quote_span: Today, the AfD once again sees Bauhaus as too modernist and globalist for the "patriotic cultural policy" the party envisions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: AfD Saxony-Anhalt cultural policy program
occurrences.quote_span: The AfD has announced that artists and institutions would be required to sign a declaration pledging "not to hold in contempt Germany and its culture" if they want to obtain state funding.
occurrences.speaker: AfD
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of Hans-Thomas Tillschneider's speech and AfD funding policy
occurrences.quote_span: "This anti-German aversion is still considered de rigueur in large parts of the theater world," he said. "We will no longer support this attitude — let me state that quite clearly."
occurrences.speaker: Hans-Thomas Tillschneider
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Adolf Hitler's 1938 Reichenberger Rede transcript and historical references
occurrences.quote_span: "'Deutsch denken' refers to a speech Adolf Hitler made in 1938" — the "Reichenberger Rede," noted Steiner.
occurrences.speaker: Barbara Steiner
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Barbara Steiner's statement to DW and historical AfD/Bauhaus criticism texts
occurrences.quote_span: "The AfD's criticism of Bauhaus picks up on criticism from 100 years ago; their wording is similar," Barbara Steiner, director of the Bauhaus Foundation, told DW.
occurrences.speaker: Barbara Steiner
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Annegret Laabs's interview with DW
occurrences.quote_span: "As cultural practitioners, cultural initiators and artists, we can say that we are now genuinely afraid, because what's being triggered there is, in fact, the idea that art and culture must be 'German,'" Annegret Laabs, director of the Kunstmuseum Magdeburg told DW.
occurrences.speaker: Annegret Laabs
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Annegret Laabs's interview with DW and historical records of artistic and cultural practice
occurrences.quote_span: "If we look at the bigger picture, we see that culture and art have been free for centuries and have known no boundaries — not even national ones. Wherever there are national boundaries, there is no longer any art or culture worthy of that name."
occurrences.speaker: Annegret Laabs
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Hans-Thomas Tillschneider's speech and records of the referenced opera production
occurrences.quote_span: He mentioned as an example an opera production he had seen some years ago; the classical German composer's work was revisited through a "feminist deconstructivist" lens that didn't please him and corresponds to what he sees as "anti-German art."
occurrences.speaker: Hans-Thomas Tillschneider
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Public funding records for Saxony-Anhalt theaters, museums and libraries and Laabs's statement to DW
occurrences.quote_span: "We all know that what we do — from theaters to museums to libraries — is paid for with taxpayer money. It wouldn't exist otherwise," said Laabs.
occurrences.speaker: Annegret Laabs
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Saxony-Anhalt cultural institution budgets and state subsidy records
occurrences.quote_span: Many of these organizations and individuals heavily rely on these subsidies.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt

occurrences.checkable_against: Hans-Thomas Tillschneider's late-June 2026 speech and AfD government program
occurrences.quote_span: "We declared in our government program that we no longer intend to spend public funds on promoting anti-German art," said Hans-Thomas Tillschneider, cultural policy spokesperson for the AfD parliamentary group in the state legislature, in a speech held in Saxony-Anhalt's parliament in late June.
occurrences.speaker: Hans-Thomas Tillschneider
occurrences.subject: AfD cultural policy in Saxony-Anhalt
